scope: Exploratory, already inspected room0 and KITTI teaser. Not held-out confirmation or a dynamic semantic benchmark.
perturbation: World x translation only, first pose fixed. Correlated order rank-sorts the nonfirst iid samples. The exact scalar multiset, mean, RMS and marginal histogram match each pair. No rotations. Deliberate monotone drift stress, not a deployment noise model.
decision: Report per-seed paired differences, static loss/change recall, reference-surface coverage/query correctness. A common adverse effect is not assumed. Same scene seeds are not independent scenes. No significance or generalization claim. H1 remains candidate; these tests do not evaluate its matched-delay benefit.
